comment: detect.c gold_detect() stale-map redraw when the only gold is underfoot (409). Dlvl 1 of seed 8813687 has two gold piles, both in rooms, no monster carrying gold, and three traps (port scan of 8813001-8814200). A debug Wizard maps the level, teleports onto each pile and picks it up, then reads a cursed scroll of gold detection: trap detection with a cursed source shows the distant traps as gold, and the out-of-sight fake gold stays in map memory. She drops her gold and reads an uncursed scroll of gold detection: clear_stale_map() removes the remembered fake gold (stale), no monster or floor gold lies away from her, so gold_detect() redraws with docrt() and reports gold between her feet.
